name: Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai

programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - 2 year
programs.feeNote: Total INR 22,50,000 = tuition 10,25,000 + programme fee 5,78,000 (academic 16,03,000) + twin-sharing AC accommodation 6,32,000 + refundable caution deposit 10,000 + alumni subscription 5,000. Hostel mandatory; food extra.
programs.intakeNote: Year-wise sanctioned intake for the 2-year PGDM (2026-28) per Mandatory Disclosure 2026; actual admissions 2026-28: 354. AICTE EOA 2026-27 lists PGDM 240 + PGDM 120 (not mapped to programme names).
programs.placementNote: Official PGDM Placement Report 2026: average CTC 15 LPA, highest 40 LPA (BFSI); median not published. Mandatory Disclosure 2026 lists 313 students placed for 2024-26. Class of 2025: average 15 LPA, highest 39.3 LPA. No audit mentioned.

selectionProcess.name: Online application with GMAT/CAT/XAT score
selectionProcess.detail: Application screening on academics, entrance score and overall profile. For 2027 intake: GMAT on/after 1 Jan 2024, CAT 2025/2026, XAT 2026/2027. Min 50% across 10th, 12th & UG; <36 months work-ex as on 30 May 2027. Profile-based early interviews also possible before scores.

selectionProcess.name: AI-proctored interview
selectionProcess.detail: Candidates who clear the AI interview are invited to the personal interview.

selectionProcess.name: Personal Interview (online)
selectionProcess.detail: Assesses general and business awareness, clarity of goals, attitude, people skills etc.; college/university rank holders get extra weightage.

selectionProcess.name: Final selection by Admissions Committee
selectionProcess.detail: Holistic evaluation; offers released to selected candidates.

keyDates.notes: PGDM 2027-29: Cycle 1 application deadline 26 Nov 2026; Cycles 2-4 deadlines TBD; PIs online.
